writeup: TIC 395051777 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 3.6331 days. The primary eclipse causes a 3.63 percent dimming of the star's light, while a secondary eclipse was detected at 6.4 sigma significance, appearing at orbital phase 0.49. Automated analysis of TESS photometry yielded a strong signal with a BLS detection significance of 232.4, and pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 15.9, though the centroid offset measured 6.3 arcseconds from the target. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it may be a previously unknown eclipsing binary system. The machine-learning pipeline assigned a screening score of 0.64 to this target, and the data passed all quality checks without flagged concerns.
